summary: Rockstar's controversial stealth-horror series, including the unrelated sequel Manhunt 2 and its censorship/version split.

entries.title: Manhunt
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version for main play; Xbox/PS2 for microphone feature preservation

emulation.emulator: Native Windows; xemu or PCSX2 for microphone-feature preservation
emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main run; console versions are secondary for microphone/headset interaction.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC version, with console microphone features as secondary

primary.why: Manhunt released on PlayStation 2, Windows, and Xbox, with later PS3/PS4 PS2 Classics re-releases. Windows is the highest-fidelity route, while PS2 and Xbox have microphone/headset features for distracting enemies and hearing director commands.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version for the main run; sample the Xbox or PS2 version only if you want the microphone/headset stealth feature.

secondary.exclusive_content: Microphone/headset input features for distracting enemies and hearing director commands
secondary.what_to_play: Try the console microphone/headset feature after the Windows main run if preserving every interaction variant matters.
secondary.why: The console versions support microphone/headset interaction that the Windows route lacks.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release and Steam availability.
Original Xbox release with Xbox Live microphone feature.
all_releases.reason: secondary: microphone/headset feature, but lower practical fidelity than Windows.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release with optional USB microphone support.
all_releases.reason: secondary: microphone feature, but lower practical fidelity than Windows.
skip: convenient route but no sourced content advantage over Windows plus console microphone routes.

all_releases.fidelity: PS2-on-PS4 re-release with 1080p and trophy support.
all_releases.reason: skip: convenient route but no sourced content advantage over Windows plus console microphone routes.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the fidelity route; PS2/Xbox have microphone/headset interaction features worth a secondary check.

entries.remaster_caveats: PS3/PS4 releases are PS2 Classics-style re-releases, not full remasters.

entries.title: Manhunt 2
entries.definitive_edition: Windows uncut AO-rated version where legally available

emulation.emulator: Native Windows, Dolphin, PCSX2, or PPSSPP
emulation.notes: Use Windows for the uncut route where legal; emulate console versions only for edited-version comparison.

primary.version: Uncut AO-rated PC version where legally available
primary.why: Manhunt 2 released on PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable, and Wii in edited M-rated form after ratings controversy. The later Windows release was the original unedited AO-rated version, making PC the completeness route where legally available in the user's region.
primary.how_to_play: Play the legally obtained Windows uncut version where available; use PS2/PSP/Wii only if you specifically want the edited console releases or Wii motion-control variant.

all_releases.fidelity: Unedited AO-rated PC release distributed digitally in select regions.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete version where legally available.

all_releases.fidelity: Edited M-rated console release with Wii motion controls.
all_releases.reason: skip: motion-control variant but censored compared with the PC release.
skip: censored compared with the PC release and no content advantage.
skip: censored and lower fidelity than the PC release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows release is both the completeness route and the practical fidelity route where legally available; console versions are edited.

entries.remaster_caveats: The uncut PC release has regional/legal availability constraints and was removed from some services; console releases were edited to obtain an M rating.
